text:
A ray of light is reflected from a plane mirror.
Which angle is the angle of reflection?
A
the angle between the incident ray and the normal
B
the angle between the incident ray and the reflected ray
C
the angle between the reflected ray and the normal
D
the angle between the reflected ray and the surface

options.label: A
options.text: the angle between the incident ray and the normal

options.label: B
options.text: the angle between the incident ray and the reflected ray

options.label: C
options.text: the angle between the reflected ray and the normal

options.label: D
options.text: the angle between the reflected ray and the surface
